the editor started

Ctrl+Shift+V pastes the value without its format
outside text loses its \r and keeps the row below
a block fills a range it divides, formulas re-based
and one undo takes the whole fill away

…and the keyboard went back to the sheet
the reader is told Bold is pressed
the full editor has no menu bar over the ribbon
every Home toolbar sits in a labelled group
no abbreviations or doubled commands on Home
the Insert drop-down opens

a menubar menu opens
the Format menu opens under Format
hovering Insert switches to the Insert menu, under Insert

the size dropdown opens
choosing 14 sets the size
…and closes the menu
right click opens the context menu
right click on a column header opens the column menu
…with column C selected
…naming the column it acts on

…and undo puts it back
right click on a row header opens the row menu
…with row 5 selected
the header arrow opens the column menu
…for column E, and not the core's popup
Ctrl+click on headers selects B and D

right click on B keeps both columns selected
a row header press selects the row, with no popup
a cell gets the cell menu back

a click ticks Match case

Close closes it
…and the query is kept

it opens again

a refused name keeps it open and says why

…as one undo

choosing a rule loads it into the form
Enter on a chosen rule updates it in place
Delete rule removes it
undo brings the deleted rule back
undo again takes the edit back
redo deletes it again
Clear takes it off, Close closes

its editor deletes it

…on that sheet
…above the tabs
